reason: It's free, it merges the Discord-plus-random-reader-tab shuffle we already do every week, and it remembers where I stopped reading — and if it sucks, the founder just kills it, so clicking the link costs me nothing.
objection: I don't love that my reading history and everything I say in chat ends up stored on a server run by someone in the group — invite-only doesn't tell me who actually holds the logs or what happens to them.
would_change_my_mind: If I found out the chat logs or reading history aren't actually private — or that the files come from somewhere sketchy — I'm out immediately.
